attributes.additional_details: Give the public a fair chance to decide for themselves who they want as the governing party.
attributes.background: The government leader is resigning and there needs to be a general now. The MP who takes over the prime ministers role has no mandate and I believe will not follow the manifest that was voted for in 2024.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

General election now – and always call one if a PM is replaced
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/771833
